# Load data

```{r load-data}
df_bite <- readr::read_rds("../data/df_clean.rds")
```

# Build chart

```{r}
df_desc <- df_bite %>%
  filter(!is.na(bite_severity)) %>%
  mutate(
    severity = factor(
      bite_severity,
      levels = 1:4,
      labels = c(
        "Score 1",
        "Score 2",
        "Score 3",
        "Score 4")),
    child_gender_table = replace_na(
      child_gender_std,
      "Missing"),
    dog_sex_table = replace_na(
      dog_sex_std,
      "Missing"),
    neuter_status = case_when(
      dog_neuter == TRUE  ~ "Sterilized",
      dog_neuter == FALSE ~ "Intact",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"),
    approach_table = case_when(
      approach_direction == "child_approached_dog" ~
        "Child approach",
      approach_direction == "dog_approached_child" ~
        "Dog approach",
      approach_direction == "mutual_approach" ~
        "Mutual approach",
      approach_direction == "unknown" ~
        "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"))

severity_levels <- levels(df_desc$severity)

fmt_n_pct <- function(n, denominator) {
  if (denominator == 0) {
    return("—")}
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / denominator)}


# Format continuous variables as Mean (SD)
fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("—")}
  m <- mean(x)
  s <- if (length(x) > 1) {
    sd(x)} 
  else {NA_real_}
  if (is.na(s)) {
    sprintf("%.2f (—)", m)} 
  else {sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", m, s)}}

# continuous variables
make_cont_row <- function(var,
                          label,
                          section) {
  overall <- fmt_mean_sd(
    df_desc[[var]])
  severity_stats <- map_chr(
    severity_levels,
    function(s) {
      fmt_mean_sd(
        df_desc[[var]][
          df_desc$severity == s])})
  values <- c(
    Overall = overall,
    setNames(
      severity_stats,
      severity_levels))
  tibble(
    Section = section,
    Variable = label) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble_row(values))}

# categorical variables
make_cat_rows <- function(var,
                          section,
                          level_order) {
  x <- as.character(
    df_desc[[var]])
  map_dfr(
    level_order,
    function(level) {
      overall_n <- sum(
        x == level,
        na.rm = TRUE)
      overall <- fmt_n_pct(
        overall_n,
        nrow(df_desc))
      severity_stats <- map_chr(
        severity_levels,
        function(s) {
          keep <- df_desc$severity == s
          n_level <- sum(
            x[keep] == level,
            na.rm = TRUE)
          fmt_n_pct(
            n_level,
            sum(keep))})
      values <- c(
        Overall = overall,
        setNames(
          severity_stats,
          severity_levels))
      tibble(
        Section = section,
        Variable = level
      ) %>%
        bind_cols(
          as_tibble_row(values))})}

# logical/checkbox vars
make_binary_rows <- function(vars,
                             section) {
  map2_dfr(
    names(vars),
    unname(vars),
    function(label, var) {
      x <- df_desc[[var]]
      overall_n <- sum(
        x == TRUE,
        na.rm = TRUE)
      overall <- fmt_n_pct(
        overall_n,
        nrow(df_desc))
      severity_stats <- map_chr(
        severity_levels,
        function(s) {
          keep <- df_desc$severity == s
          n_true <- sum(
            x[keep] == TRUE,
            na.rm = TRUE)
          fmt_n_pct(
            n_true,
            sum(keep))})
      values <- c(
        Overall = overall,
        setNames(
          severity_stats,
          severity_levels))
      tibble(
        Section = section,
        Variable = label
      ) %>%
        bind_cols(
          as_tibble_row(values))})}

# dependent variables
## conflict behavior
conflict_vars <- c(
  "Conflict-defusing" =
    "conflict_defusing",
  "Conflict-avoiding" =
    "conflict_avoiding",
  "Conflict-escalating" =
    "conflict_escalating")

## triggers 
dog_trigger_cols <- names(df_desc) %>%
  str_subset("^triggered_bite__") %>%
  setdiff(c("triggered_bite__other",
            "triggered_bite__other_clean"))

trigger_vars <- dog_trigger_cols

names(trigger_vars) <- trigger_vars %>%
  str_remove("^triggered_bite__") %>%
  str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
  str_to_sentence()

# dog personality
dog_personality_cols <- names(df_desc) %>%
  str_subset("^dog_personality__") %>%
  setdiff(c(
    "dog_personality__other",
    "dog_personality__other_clean"))

dog_personality_vars <- dog_personality_cols

names(dog_personality_vars) <-
  dog_personality_vars %>%
  str_remove("^dog_personality__") %>%
  str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
  str_to_sentence()

# child personality
child_personality_cols <- names(df_desc) %>%
  str_subset("^personality_at_bite__") %>%
  setdiff(c(
    "personality_at_bite__other",
    "personality_at_bite__other_clean"))

child_personality_vars <-
  child_personality_cols

names(child_personality_vars) <-
  child_personality_vars %>%
  str_remove("^personality_at_bite__") %>%
  str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
  str_to_sentence()

# BUILD TABLE
descriptive_table <- bind_rows(
## child
  make_cont_row(
    "child_age_years",
    "Child age, years",
    "Child characteristics"),
  make_cat_rows(
    "child_gender_table",
    "Child characteristics",
    c("Female",
      "Male",
      "Prefer not to say")),
  ## dog
  make_cont_row(
    "dog_age_years",
    "Dog age, years",
    "Dog characteristics"),
  make_cat_rows(
    "dog_sex_table",
    "Dog characteristics",
    c("Female",
      "Male")),
  make_cat_rows(
    "neuter_status",
    "Dog characteristics",
    c("Sterilized",
      "Intact")),
  ## conflict behaviors
  make_cont_row(
    "dog_warning_count",
    "Number of conflict behaviors reported",
    "Conflict behaviors prior to bite"),
  make_binary_rows(
    conflict_vars,
    "Conflict behaviors prior to bite"),
  ## approach direction
  make_cat_rows(
    "approach_table",
    "Approach direction",
    c("Child approach",
      "Dog approach",
      "Mutual approach",
      "Unknown")))

severity_n <- table(df_desc$severity)

names(descriptive_table)[3:7] <- c(
  paste0(
    "Overall (N = ",
    nrow(df_desc),
    ")"),
  paste0(
    severity_levels,
    " (n = ",
    as.integer(severity_n[
      severity_levels]),
    ")"))

# print
knitr::kable(
  descriptive_table,
  align = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
  caption = paste0(
    "Descriptive characteristics of bite incidents ",
    "overall and by bite severity score"))
```

# warning signals grouped by behavioral response
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

warning_plot <- tribble(
  ~warning_signal,              ~activity,              ~n,
  "Whale eye",                  "Conflict-defusing",     2,
  "Tucked tail",                "Conflict-avoiding",     3,
  "Raised hackles",             "Conflict-avoiding",     2,
  "Cowered away",               "Conflict-avoiding",     1,
  "Air snapped",                "Conflict-escalating",   4,
  "Lunged",                     "Conflict-escalating",   2,
  "Growled",                    "Conflict-escalating",   2,
  "Barked",                     "Conflict-escalating",   1,
  "Bared teeth / lifted lips",  "Conflict-escalating",   1
)

# Incident-level totals from your current Figure 2B
activity_totals <- tribble(
  ~activity,              ~incidents, ~percent,
  "Conflict-defusing",           2,       6.2,
  "Conflict-avoiding",           4,      12.5,
  "Conflict-escalating",         8,      25.0
)

# Create informative facet labels
activity_labels <- activity_totals |>
  mutate(
    facet_label = paste0(
      activity, " — ",
      incidents, " incidents (", percent, "%)"
    )
  ) |>
  select(activity, facet_label)

warning_plot <- warning_plot |>
  left_join(activity_labels, by = "activity")

# Set ordering
warning_plot <- warning_plot |>
  mutate(
    facet_label = factor(
      facet_label,
      levels = activity_labels$facet_label
    ),
    warning_signal = factor(
      warning_signal,
      levels = rev(c(
        "Whale eye",
        "Tucked tail",
        "Raised hackles",
        "Cowered away",
        "Air snapped",
        "Lunged",
        "Growled",
        "Barked",
        "Bared teeth / lifted lips"
      ))
    )
  )

ggplot(
  warning_plot,
  aes(x = n, y = warning_signal, fill = activity)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    hjust = -0.35,
    size = 3.7
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    facet_label ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Conflict-defusing"   = "#4C78A8",
      "Conflict-avoiding"   = "#F2A12D",
      "Conflict-escalating" = "#D83B3B"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:4,
    limits = c(0, 4.7),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .02))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Number of warning signals reported",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    strip.text.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11,
      angle = 0
    ),

    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),

    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),

    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
  )
```

# bite severity X age
```{r}
# verify vars
df_bite %>%
  select(
    bite_severity,
    dog_age_years,
    child_age_years
  ) %>%
  summary()

# check NAs
df_bite %>%
  summarise(
    bite_severity_NA = sum(is.na(bite_severity)),
    dog_age_NA = sum(is.na(dog_age_years)),
    child_age_NA = sum(is.na(child_age_years)))

# visual 
age_severity_plot <- df_bite %>%
  select(
    bite_severity,
    child_age_years,
    dog_age_years
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(child_age_years, dog_age_years),
    names_to = "age_type",
    values_to = "age_years"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    age_type = recode(
      age_type,
      child_age_years = "Child age",
      dog_age_years = "Dog age"
    ),
    bite_severity = factor(
      bite_severity,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4)))

ggplot(
  age_severity_plot,
  aes(
    x = bite_severity,
    y = age_years
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.55,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ age_type,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Bite severity score",
    y = "Age (years)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"))

# OR SWITCH AXIS
age_severity_plot <- df_bite %>%
  select(
    bite_severity,
    child_age_years,
    dog_age_years
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(child_age_years, dog_age_years),
    names_to = "age_type",
    values_to = "age_years"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    age_type = recode(
      age_type,
      child_age_years = "Child age",
      dog_age_years = "Dog age"))

ggplot(
  age_severity_plot,
  aes(
    x = age_years,
    y = bite_severity
  )
) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0,
    height = 0.08,
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ age_type,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    limits = c(0.75, 4.25)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Bite severity score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"))

# color coded
age_severity_plot <- df_bite %>%
  mutate(case_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    case_id,
    bite_severity,
    child_age_years,
    dog_age_years
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(child_age_years, dog_age_years),
    names_to = "age_type",
    values_to = "age_years"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    age_type = recode(
      age_type,
      child_age_years = "Child age",
      dog_age_years = "Dog age"
    ), 
    severity_plot = case_when(
      age_type == "Child age" ~ bite_severity + 0.07,
      age_type == "Dog age"   ~ bite_severity - 0.07))

ggplot(
  age_severity_plot,
  aes(
    x = age_years,
    y = severity_plot,
    color = age_type,
    shape = age_type
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Child age" = "#4C78A8",
      "Dog age"   = "#F2A12D"
    )
  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Child age" = 16,
      "Dog age"   = 16
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = 1:4,
    limits = c(0.75, 4.25)
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      ceiling(max(age_severity_plot$age_years, na.rm = TRUE)),
      by = 2
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Bite severity score",
    color = NULL,
    shape = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),

    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.position = "top",

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 11))
```
